mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(t.id) AS count FROM dmp_output_task_record_his t WHERE t.is_deleted = false
${permissionSql}

SELECT COUNT(t.id) AS count from (select id,main_id,create_time,field_value,remark,cfg_output_id,source_code,t4.update_time,status,is_need_sync from dmp_cfg_output_black t1 left join (select t2.is_need_sync,t3.cfg_output_id,t2.source_code,t2.update_time,t2.status from dmp_output_task_record t2 left join dmp_output_task t3 on t2.main_id = t3.id where t2.is_deleted = 'f' and t3.is_deleted = 'f') t4 on t1.main_id = t4.cfg_output_id and t1.field_value = t4.source_code where t1.field_value != '' and t1.compare_sign = 'eq' and t1.create_user_id != '' and t1.is_deleted = 'f') t LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_output h ON t.main_id = h.id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_input_convert j ON h.input_convert_id = j.id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_input k ON j.main_id = k.id LEFT JOIN dmp_basic_system l ON k.system_id = l.id LEFT JOIN dmp_basic_system i ON h.system_id = i.id where ${params.sqlMap.default}
${permissionSql}

SELECT t.id, l."name" AS sourcePlatformName, i.name AS targetPlatformName, k.name AS sourceTypeName, t.source_code AS sourceCode, t.status AS status, t.create_time, t.update_time AS lastSyncTime, t.response_data AS returnMsg, t.is_need_sync AS isNeedSync FROM dmp_output_task_record t LEFT JOIN dmp_output_task g ON t.main_id = g.id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_output h ON g.cfg_output_id = h.id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_input_convert j ON h.input_convert_id = j.id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_input k ON j.main_id = k.id LEFT JOIN dmp_basic_system l ON k.system_id = l.id LEFT JOIN dmp_basic_system i ON h.system_id = i.id WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} AND t.is_deleted = false
${params.permissionSql}

SELECT T.* FROM dmp_output_task_record T LEFT JOIN dmp_output_task G ON T.main_id = G. ID LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_output h ON G.cfg_output_id = h.ID WHERE T.is_deleted = 'f' AND G.is_deleted = 'f' AND h.is_deleted = 'f' AND ( T.status IN ( 'init', 'mqerror', 'cosumererror' ) OR ( T.status = 'mqsuccess' AND T.update_time < ( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7200 seconds' ) ) ) AND h.system_id = #{systemId} ORDER BY T.update_time LIMIT #{size}
select id from dmp_input_mongo_dmp_relation where update_time < #{beforeUpdateTime} limit #{size};

delete.if: insert into dmp_input_file_mongo_relation_his select * from dmp_input_file_mongo_relation where id in (${fileConditionSql}); delete from dmp_input_file_mongo_relation where id in (${fileConditionSql});
insert into dmp_input_mongo_dmp_relation_his select * from dmp_input_mongo_dmp_relation where id in (${dmpConditionSql}); delete from dmp_input_mongo_dmp_relation where id in (${dmpConditionSql});

mapper.select: select t.id from dmp_output_task t where update_time < #{beforeUpdateTime} and status = 'finish' and not exists (select 1 from dmp_output_task_record g where g.status in ('init','mqsuccess','mqerror' , 'cosumererror' , 'error') and g.main_id = t.id ) order by t.update_time limit #{size};
select g.id from dmp_output_task g where status = 'finish' and exec_system = 'dmp' and not exists (select 1 from dmp_output_task_record t where t.main_id = g.id);
mapper.delete: insert into dmp_output_task_his select * from dmp_output_task g where g.id in (${conditionSql}); delete from dmp_output_task g where g.id in (${conditionSql});
mapper.select: SELECT dotr.* FROM dmp_output_task_record AS dotr LEFT JOIN dmp_output_task AS dor ON dor.ID = dotr.main_id WHERE dor.cfg_output_id = #{cfgOutputId} AND dotr.source_code = #{sourceCode} AND dotr.source_code NOT IN ( '', '_' ) AND dotr.is_deleted = FALSE AND dor.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT dotr.* FROM dmp_output_task_record AS dotr LEFT JOIN dmp_output_task AS dor ON dor.ID = dotr.main_id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_output AS dco on dco.id = dor.cfg_output_id WHERE dco.output_class = #{outputClass} AND dotr.source_code = #{sourceCode} AND dotr.is_deleted = FALSE AND dor.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY dotr.create_time desc

SELECT concat('【' , k.name , '】推送【' , i.name , '】失败：' , count(*)) FROM dmp_output_task_record t LEFT JOIN dmp_output_task g ON t.main_id = g.id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_output h ON g.cfg_output_id = h.id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_input_convert j ON h.input_convert_id = j.id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_input k ON j.main_id = k.id LEFT JOIN dmp_basic_system l ON k.system_id = l.id LEFT JOIN dmp_basic_system i ON h.system_id = i.id LEFT JOIN dmp_cfg_output_black dcob ON t.source_code = dcob.field_value AND h.id = dcob.main_id AND dcob.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE t.status = 'error' AND t.is_deleted = false and t.create_time < current_date and l.id is not null and i.id is not null and k.id is not null group by l."name",i.name,k.name order by k.name,i.name,count(*) desc

WITH RankedTasks AS ( SELECT dit.start_time, dit.end_time, dit.create_time as lastSyncTime, dit.status, dci.bill_type, dbs.code as platform, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY dci.bill_type, dbs.code ORDER BY dit.create_time DESC ) as rn FROM dmp_input_task dit INNER JOIN dmp_cfg_input dci ON dit.cfg_input_id = dci.id AND dci.is_deleted = false INNER JOIN dmp_basic_system dbs ON dci.system_id = dbs.id AND dbs.is_deleted = false WHERE dit.is_deleted = false ) SELECT start_time, end_time, create_time, status, bill_type, platform FROM RankedTasks WHERE rn = 1 AND bill_type = #{params.billType} AND platform = #{params.platform};
